fields.label: Domain
fields.description: The domain the report is about, as the reporter names it: the one whose DMARC record was evaluated.

fields.label: Mail Domain
fields.description: The Mail Domain that carries the policy domain. Left empty when no site holds it (the cluster's own domain, for instance).

fields.label: Suite Site
fields.description: The site that held the domain when the report was fetched; the site API shows the report to this site only.

fields.label: Stalwart Cluster
fields.description: The cluster that intercepted the report. Stalwart parses reports mailed to postmaster@ and keeps them for a month.

fields.label: Stalwart ID
fields.description: The id of the DmarcExternalReport object on the cluster; with the cluster it says whether a report is stored already.

fields.label: Reporter
fields.description: The organisation that evaluated the mail and sent the report, such as google.com.

fields.label: Reporter Email
fields.description: Where the reporter takes questions about the report.

fields.label: Reporter Contact
fields.description: Any further contact detail the reporter added.

fields.label: Report ID
fields.description: The reporter's own id for the report; the same report resent carries the same id.

fields.label: Range Begins
fields.description: The start of the period the report covers, usually one day.

fields.label: Range Ends
fields.description: The end of the period the report covers.

fields.label: Received At
fields.description: When the cluster received the report.

fields.label: Expires On Cluster
fields.description: When Stalwart drops its copy; the report stays here until the retention in Suite Cloud Settings runs out.

fields.label: Messages
fields.description: Messages the reporter saw from this domain in the period, summed over the records.

fields.label: Passed DMARC
fields.description: Messages that passed DMARC: aligned DKIM or aligned SPF verified.

fields.label: Failed DMARC
fields.description: Messages that failed both aligned checks; the published policy decided their fate.

fields.label: Passed DKIM
fields.description: Messages with a verified, aligned DKIM signature.

fields.label: Passed SPF
fields.description: Messages whose envelope sender passed an aligned SPF check.

fields.label: Published Policy
fields.description: The DMARC record as the reporter read it when it evaluated the messages.

fields.label: Policy (p)
fields.description: The p tag the reporter read: none, quarantine or reject.

fields.label: Subdomain Policy (sp)
fields.description: The sp tag: the policy for subdomains, when it differs from p.

fields.label: Percentage (pct)
fields.description: The pct tag: the share of failing messages the policy was applied to.

fields.label: DKIM Alignment (adkim)
fields.description: The adkim tag: whether DKIM alignment was relaxed or strict.

fields.label: SPF Alignment (aspf)
fields.description: The aspf tag: whether SPF alignment was relaxed or strict.

fields.label: Reporter Errors
fields.description: Remarks the reporter added, such as a DNS lookup it could not complete.

fields.label: Records
fields.description: One row per source IP and result combination, as the reporter grouped the messages.

fields.label: Report
fields.description: The report exactly as the cluster parsed it, for anything the fields above leave out.
